apps.name: PocketWP
apps.subtitle: A complete WordPress that runs fully offline
apps.localizedDescription:
PocketWP runs a complete WordPress site fully offline – right on your iPhone or iPad. No hosting, no server, no internet connection required. The app bundles WordPress with a real PHP runtime (WordPress Playground, PHP compiled to WebAssembly), so everything runs locally inside the app.

Everything you create – pages, posts, settings, media, plugins and themes – is saved automatically to the app's private storage and restored the next time you open it.

FEATURES
• A real, full WordPress – the admin dashboard, block editor, themes and plugins you already know
• 100% offline: works in airplane mode, on the train, anywhere
• Automatic local backup and restore of your content
• Install your own plugins and themes from a ZIP file
• Upload media directly from your device
• Privacy first: no account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics

Ideal for learning WordPress, prototyping a site, drafting content on the go, or testing plugins and themes in a safe, sandboxed environment.

Note: WordPress and WordPress Playground are open-source projects of the WordPress community. PocketWP is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the WordPress Foundation or Automattic.
